detail.longDescription: 📜 NEW: Researchers gathered at the University of # Michigan ’s # Papyrus # Conservation # Summer Seminar to save ancient fragments nicknamed "cornflakes." Nine conservators largely new to the work preserved more than 150 pieces in two weeks, working alongside papyrologists so text specialists and conservators could guide each other’s efforts. 👉 https://www. popsci.com/science/cornflakes- ancient-writing-papyrus/ # history # archaeology # museums # science # preservation # research # breakfast # writing
